import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Remove duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)
    
    # Standardize Category values to title case and strip whitespace
    df['Category'] = df['Category'].str.strip().str.title()
    
    # Convert Price: remove non-numeric characters and convert to float
    df['Price'] = df['Price'].astype(str).str.replace(r'[^0-9.]', '', regex=True).astype(float)
    
    # Recalculate Revenue to ensure correctness
    df['Revenue'] = df['Quantity'] * df['Price']
    
    # Convert Date to datetime
    df['Date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Date'])
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    df['Month'] = df['Date'].dt.to_period('M').astype(str)
    result = df.groupby('Month')['Revenue'].sum().round(2).to_dict()
    return result
